title: Binary expansion from floor digits
statement: For a real number $\rho$ with $0\le\rho<1$, define the $i$th binary digit to be true exactly when the integer part of $2^{i+1}\rho$ is odd. The sum over all $i\ge0$ of these digits, weighted by $2^{-(i+1)}$, equals $\rho$.
